theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) combined with Archetype 1 (Organic/Matte) for a premium, trustworthy auction house feel.
theme_and_archetype.vibe: A modern, high-end marketplace. Think premium art/watch auctions meets seamless e-commerce. Exciting but restrained—tension comes from the live data, not flashy gradients.
core_principles: Motion-First Minimalism: Use maximum restraint in static UI, but maximum impact in real-time interactions (smooth pulses, snappy data updates).
The Hero-Cover Pattern: The landing page hero should be immersive, using high-quality lifestyle/product photography.
Data Legibility First: Bids, countdowns, and financial figures must use monospace typography for instant parsing.
Urgency through Subtlety: Use signal colors (Terracotta) for critical states like 'Outbid' or '< 1 min remaining', rather than generic red.

primary_heading.usage: H1, H2, and large marketing display text. Must use tight tracking (tracking-tight).

secondary_body.usage: Paragraphs, standard UI text, item descriptions.

monospace_data.usage: Countdown timers, current bid amounts, and live feed logs. Gives the 'command center / live market' feel.

rules: CRITICAL: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk anywhere in this project.
Labels/Overlines must be uppercase, tiny (text-xs), and widely spaced (tracking-[0.2em]).
CRITICAL: NO purple-gradient AI slop. Stick to the premium organic/swiss palette.
Use #CB5A3C (Terracotta) for 'Outbid' warnings, 'Ending Soon' timers, and urgent notifications.
Use #1C3F35 (Deep Forest Green) for Primary CTAs ('Place Bid', 'Create Auction') as it represents trust and commerce.
Never use pure black (#000000). Use #111111 for high contrast without eye strain.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Use Bento Grid (Mode A) for the Marketing Landing page to create visual tension. Use 'Control Room' grid (Mode B) for Admin & User Dashboards for maximum data density.
spacing_and_layout.container_padding: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 inside primary cards to let content breathe.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: Subtle roundness. Max 8px (rounded-lg) for a modern, crisp, 'brutalist-elegant' aesthetic.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px border-black/5 for crisp edges on cards and list items. Never rely entirely on soft shadows.

components.strategy: Hybrid approach. Use raw HTML/Tailwind for expressive marketing/landing sections. Heavily customize Shadcn components for forms, tables, and dashboards.
components.buttons: Flat surfaces, crisp edges. Primary: bg-[#1C3F35] text-white. Hover state: -translate-y-[1px] shadow-sm.
components.cards: Cardless approach or very subtle 1px border. Background should match parent (#FAFAFA) or use pure white (#FFFFFF).
components.inputs: Shadcn-based. Customize focus state to: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1C3F35]/20. No aggressive glowing outlines.
components.navigation: Glassmorphism sticky header for marketing pages: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with a delicate 1px border-b border-black/5.
components.real_time_indicators: The WOW factor. Add a tiny dot with 'animate-ping' next to 'Live' tags. Use soft green for active auctions, pulsing terracotta for auctions ending in < 1 minute.
libraries: framer-motion (For bid pulses, list reordering, toast reveals)

testing.data_testid_rules: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) and key informational elements (current bid price, timer) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case. Example: data-testid='place-bid-button'.
